model.title: Declared trapezoidal excavation volume
assumptions: Uniform declared trench section; soil stability and excavation protections are external requirements.

model.title: Declared-period discounted cashflow
assumptions: Explicit elapsed times or uniform periods with time-zero first cashflow; no cost-year or currency conversion.

model.title: Operational energy, cost and declared emissions
assumptions: Supplied duty, signed tariff and emissions factor; unknown factors remain null; not a lifecycle result.

model.title: Real-fluid isentropic-reference compressor
assumptions: Steady adiabatic single-phase compression with declared isentropic efficiency.

model.title: Installed gas control-valve coefficient
assumptions: Gas reference volume at 273.15 K and 101325 Pa; explicit manufacturer factors.

model.title: Installed liquid control-valve coefficient
assumptions: Library sizing correlation with explicitly supplied manufacturer factors and diameters.

model.title: Similar-pump operating-point scaling
assumptions: Geometrically similar pumps with unchanged efficiency; not a generic impeller-trim model.

model.title: Available suction head and declared vendor margin
assumptions: Steady suction energy budget with a declared surface pressure, vapour pressure and vendor NPSH.

model.title: Pump hydraulic, shaft and electrical power
assumptions: Steady liquid flow and independently declared pump/motor efficiencies.

model.title: Identical-pump and equivalent-system operating point
assumptions: Caller-owned monotone pump curve and static-plus-quadratic system head.
Identical series/parallel pumps and declared constant efficiencies.

model.title: Gas relief-area correlation adapter
assumptions: Single-phase gas correlation; declared coefficients, back pressure and relieving load.

model.title: Pipe flow and wall geometry
assumptions: Circular uniform pipe geometry and declared wall density.

model.title: Selectable empirical gas pipeline correlation
assumptions: Empirical directed gas flow with declared mean temperature, compressibility, efficiency and reference conditions.
The selected correlation's original regime must be reviewed for the target gas and pipe.

model.title: Hydrostatic absolute pressure
assumptions: Constant-density stationary fluid under declared gravity.

model.title: Isothermal gas mass-flow calculation
assumptions: Steady horizontal isothermal gas; supplied average density and friction.

model.title: Signed liquid hydraulic head demand without density
assumptions: Steady single-phase Newtonian kinematic-viscosity input; no density or absolute pressure is inferred.
Darcy convention; transition treatment is explicit and shared with the pressure-loss owner.
The result is a required head difference, not an absolute pressure state or measured sensor mapping.

model.title: Signed liquid pressure and energy budget
assumptions: Steady single-phase constant-property flow; no cavitation or two-phase closure.
Darcy convention; transition treatment is explicit.

model.title: Liquid differential-pressure flow meter
assumptions: Incompressible single-phase flow with externally reviewed discharge coefficient and geometry.

model.title: Spatially declared real-fluid inventory integration
assumptions: Caller supplies resolved spatial segments and a common fluid/property reference.
Every state is individually single phase; no transport or interface motion is inferred.

model.title: Uniform real-fluid inventory and reference volume
assumptions: Uniform single-phase actual and reference states; no unknown phase or stratification inferred.

model.title: Constant-property flow thermal relaxation
assumptions: Constant ambient, heat capacity and total conductance without phase change.

model.title: Unrestrained linear thermal expansion
assumptions: Small linear unrestrained expansion with a declared coefficient.

model.title: Selectable internal-flow convection correlation
assumptions: Single-phase internal flow with independently checked thermal boundary and regime.

model.title: Simple-wave pressure pulse and closure timescale
assumptions: Joukowsky pulse scale in a uniform liquid line; not a reflected-wave transient simulation.

model.title: Elastic-pipe liquid wave speed
assumptions: Linear small-disturbance fluid and wall compliance; caller supplies restraint coefficient.
